findings.title: Permanent CCC round deadlock has bounded terminal recovery
evidence: Round stores commit_timestamp and terminal status
settle_round rejects at and after the exact 86,400-second boundary
expire_round is permissionless only at and after that boundary
expiry preserves the original snapshot and accepts no replacement randomness
CCC settlement accepts EXPIRED_NEUTRAL and pays floor(full * (N-1) / N)
residualRisk: No fresh signed Devnet evidence for the changed layout and instruction set

findings.title: Reveal controller retains profitable reveal-versus-neutral-expiry optionality
evidence: The randomness authority learns the revealed selected agency
A successful reveal produces a selected-agency payout vector
Silence produces a different all-agency neutral payout vector
An agency-aligned controller can condition its choice on which vector benefits it
remediation: Remove unilateral economically interested reveal authority, or enforce objectively slashable collateral greater than maximum withholding gain
Model collusion, bribery, signer loss, oracle outage, and candidate concentration
Obtain independent Solana randomness and game-theory review

findings.title: Remediation source lacks instruction-level local-validator and fresh signed Devnet evidence
evidence: Host/model boundary tests and verifiable SBF build pass
Earlier Explorer transactions bind a prior program layout and binary
No signed transaction exercises expire_round or EXPIRED_NEUTRAL settlement
remediation: Execute before-boundary rejection, exact-boundary expiry, post-expiry replay rejection, and linked-position settlement in local-validator
Repeat the reviewed flow on Devnet with independent source/binary/evidence hash comparison

findings.title: Upgrade, administration, and community custody authority remain correlated
evidence: PROGRAM_ADMIN and COMMUNITY_CUSTODY remain the same address
The planned authority separation and timelocked multisig design is not implemented in this increment
remediation: Implement and publish distinct role addresses with threshold/timelock policy
Exercise signer-loss, compromise, emergency pause, and upgrade-delay procedures
Bind independent review to final ProgramData authority and bytecode
